answer: Counterparty diversity stops sybil farms. Each agent must trade with 12 distinct counterparties per epoch. A lagoon of fake identities trading only among themselves fails. One shared inlet of funds marks the cluster: identities fed from one source are flagged, bonds frozen. Forging 100 identities costs 100x15=1,500 POA in bonds plus 1,200 trades to reach the summit, against a ~900 POA pool share. Honest agents pay once and keep the full share.
